C-PREFERENCES-SYNC-FULL-SCREEN.IntentSummary: Keep Preferences and Sync in the alternate terminal screen and expand their shared frame to the available terminal area using main-view styling, with responsive bounds and preserved interactions.

MustContain.Text: Preferences and Sync remain in the alternate terminal screen

T-001.Title: Render Preferences and Sync as full-screen destinations

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: In records_view.go, enable alternate-screen mode for both secondary views, preserving the main view's terminal configuration where appropriate.

In the shared secondaryFrame helper, derive the usable panel dimensions from the current terminal size minus outer spacing and the border/padding frame, and explicitly expand the panel in both dimensions.
Reuse BaseStyle and PanelSpacing, with the active-panel border color and one-row vertical and two-column horizontal outer spacing when space permits.

Keep each existing title, action list, status message, and return hint; account for their space before rendering, constrain long text and tiny terminal output to bounds, and recompute dimensions on resize.

Keep preference persistence, weight conversion, remote dispatch, and keyboard handlers unchanged. Preserve existing edits and synchronize file-local module contracts, maps, and block anchors for edited governed files.

T-002.Title: Verify full-screen dimensions, terminal modes, and retained interactions

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add TestPreferencesFullScreenLayout and TestSyncFullScreenLayout in their existing test files. Assert alternate-screen mode and exact expanded border extents and outer spacing at 100x40, rather than checking only that output is smaller than the terminal.
Exercise wide, compact, and tiny sizes, including zero dimensions, and resize while each screen is active. Assert output bounds, useful content where space allows, and long/error status bounds.

Add TestSecondaryScreenStatePreservation in records_navigation_test.go. From both active panels, verify p/s entry and q/esc return, alternate-screen mode across transitions, and retained selections, page, and scroll state without unintended record actions.
Retain coverage for preference persistence and visible weight conversion, Sync store/load dispatch and unavailable/error/success status messages, and the existing ge/gs shortcuts.

Use repository-compliant Go formatting and meaningful rendering or interaction assertions. Do not regenerate existing records/help/dialog snapshots, because their intended rendering is outside this change.

T-003.Title: Apply scoped GRACE updates and verify the integrated change

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Update only M-TUI-RECORDS and M-TUI-PREFERENCES-SYNC in graph/main.xml to describe alternate-screen routing and responsive expanded frames. Include the sentence fragment required by TargetAssertions.
Update only V-M-TUI-RECORDS and V-M-TUI-PREFERENCES-SYNC in verification/main.xml with the layout, terminal-mode, resize, and state-preservation scenarios and named test evidence.
Retain existing graph and verification ownership; no index or context writes are required. Preserve all unrelated projection entries.
Pass the full test suite and vet without UPDATE_GOLDEN=1, and use selected target and final GRACE checks externally through grace-execute before applying and archiving this bundle.
